summary: Temporary crane near Glasgow navigation beacon may cause bearing fluctuations on radials 070 to 110 degrees magnetic.
text:
VOR/DME GOW/GLASGOW 115.40 MHZ CH101X THERE MAY BE OBSERVATIONS OF
DVOR BEARING FLUCTUATIONS WITHIN THE 070-110 DEG. MAG. SECTOR
RADIALS FROM THE GLASGOW VOR/DME STATION, DUE TO A TEMPORARY CRANE
IN THE VICINITY
